question: How do two evidence-backed chart-only translations of Ross Cameron's favorable trade management behave on the frozen July Micro paths without changing selection, entry, sizing, or the prospective account study?
hypothesis: A causal management layer will close some positions before the original stop and will preserve favorable runners; selling half at the first two-R milestone and moving the remainder to breakeven will differ materially from holding the full position until the first completed red candle.

fixed_entry_cohorts.engineering: every already-frozen Micro-v0.1 filled plan in the source runtime
fixed_entry_cohorts.account_overlay: only entries already accepted in each frozen historical-account-diagnostic-v0.1 session artifact
fixed_entry_cohorts.reason: Changing exits can change later buying-power availability. Recomputing acceptance would change both management and portfolio chronology, so v0.1 intentionally keeps the entry set fixed.

event_contract.initial_risk_per_share: actual frozen SIP execution-proxy fill minus original Micro plan stop
event_contract.two_r_target: actual fill plus two times initial risk per share
event_contract.completed_red_candle: bar close strictly below bar open; signal becomes available only at bar_start plus bar_seconds
event_contract.red_candle_execution: first execution-eligible SIP print at or after signal availability
event_contract.stop_execution: first later execution-eligible SIP print at or below the active stop; observed print price is retained
event_contract.target_execution: first later execution-eligible SIP print at or above the target; exact target price is used as the limit-fill proxy
event_contract.unresolved_behavior: retain remaining position fraction with no invented mark or session-close exit

unchanged_components: entry execution proxy and zero-millisecond registered latency
prohibited_runtime_inputs: Ross entries, exits, fills, profit or recap judgments
later-session labels used to select a cell
Level 2 quotes or depth not present in the frozen source
inferred aggressor side not supplied by the SIP trades
future bars before their completion timestamp
explicitly_deferred: fees, spread, latency, queue position, partial fills and market impact

required_outputs: filled-plan outcome counts and weighted realized R by cell
fixed-entry main and small account outcome counts and realized P&L by cell

decision_gate: Retain only as shadow evidence. No cell may be selected or promoted from this July result. A future choice requires a separately frozen rule or genuinely prospective paper evidence.
